text: Officer {Name} lost a younger sibling in fighting. During a posting near {Place}, the bereaved officer repeatedly gave one young recruit safer kitchen duties while other recruits went on patrol.
self_review: A bereaved officer repeatedly favored one young recruit with safer duties after losing a younger sibling in fighting.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not establish bereavement producing this kind of favoritism.
fictional_changes: The sibling's death, recruit, assignment choices, and connection between them are entirely fictional.
